fields.label: Email Subject

fields.default:
Dear Sir/Madam,

This is with reference to your Sales Invoice {{ doc.name }} dated {{ doc.get_formatted('posting_date') }}.

According to our records, a payment of {{ doc.get_formatted('outstanding_amount') }} is currently pending against this invoice.

We kindly request you to look into this and arrange for the payment at your earliest convenience.

If you have any concerns regarding the invoice or if there is a discrepancy, please let us know so we can resolve it immediately.

If the payment is already being made, kindly ignore this email since it is a system generated email.

Thank you for your continued business.

Thanks & Best Regards,
Accounts Receivable Team
Komal Scientific
